risk_description: Stale status information may reduce trust and increase escalation
Simplification may omit important edge-case or eligibility nuance
Digital workflow may shift work to users with lower access or confidence
Escalation pathway may create unsustainable frontline workload
Intervention may depend on community partners without adequate support
Dashboard metrics may encourage optimization of visible indicators only
Findings may not reach decision-makers with authority to act
Equity monitoring may expose sensitive subgroup information if poorly governed
